one_line_contribution: A reliability-quantified source-by-target warm-start transfer matrix for *textual* optimized prompts, plus the specific falsifiable claim that a cheap 10-dimensional judge-labeled failure-mode profile predicts that matrix substantially better than SPoT-style semantic/task-embedding similarity, cashed out as a leave-one-target-out router that can abstain to cold start.
closest_prior_work: Vu et al. 2020 ('Exploring and Predicting Transferability') and SPoT/ATTEMPT are the direct methodological ancestors: they already build a full source-by-target transfer matrix and already test similarity-based predictors of it, including a retrieval rule for picking a source. The proposal concedes the shape is the same and rests its novelty on (a) the medium (text rather than soft prompts) and (b) the predictor (failure signatures rather than task embeddings). The brief itself warns that the medium swap is a modest delta, so essentially all novelty weight lands on (b) — and (b) is itself a composition of two existing pieces: adapter/module routing work (LoraHub, Arrow/MBC-style library routing) already does leave-one-target-out source selection with a fallback, and error-taxonomy-driven prompt optimizers (ProTeGi's beam search over judge-identified error feedback, PromptAgent's error-trace-conditioned MCTS) already treat judge-labeled failure modes as the informative summary of a task. 'Failure modes are the transferable structure' is therefore not a fresh premise; only its use as a *routing feature* is, and that is one idea, not a paper's worth. The genuinely uncontested piece is the split-half reliability measurement of the transfer matrix, which prior transfer studies do not report — but that is a methodological audit, not the advertised claim.
strongest_objection: Prediction (b) — failure-signature similarity at Spearman 0.45-0.65 versus semantic similarity at 0.0-0.25, a margin of at least 0.2 with a bootstrap CI excluding zero — is not testable with the eight tasks chosen, because across those eight the failure profile is a near-deterministic function of the domain. GSM8K will load on 'arithmetic/bookkeeping slip', MBPP on 'format/contract violation', HotpotQA on 'unsupported claim', the instruction-following set on 'instruction omission'. The two candidate predictors are therefore collinear by construction, and whichever wins is a fact about which sentence encoder was used for the task-embedding arm, not evidence about 'what feature space transfer lives in'. The design needs pairs that dissociate the predictors — semantically near but failure-far, and semantically far but failure-near — and the task-selection criterion never mentions this. Compounding it: only 8 signature vectors exist, so the 56 pairwise similarities have on the order of 8 effective degrees of freedom, the head-to-head is tested by a bootstrap clustered on target (8 clusters), and both correlations are first divided by a split-half reliability estimated from 3 seeds per cell (which cannot even be split into halves evenly). The stated power calculation — Spearman 0.27 detectable at 80% power with 56 cells — is for a *single* correlation with cells treated as independent, which directly contradicts the clustered-bootstrap analysis plan and says nothing about power for the *difference* of two attenuation-corrected correlations. The paper's central number is thus below its own detection threshold, exactly the failure mode the research brief flagged as having sunk the previous round. A secondary technical objection: 'the reflection proposal stream is replayed to remove proposal randomness' is not implementable between warm-start and cold-start arms, since the reflector is conditioned on different prompts and traces in the two arms; fixing a sampling seed does not yield matched proposals, and the pairing is weaker than claimed. Third, there is an unaddressed tension between arm (2)'s domain-scrubbing and prediction (a)'s required 6-point spread between best and worst source: the better the scrub works, the more the sources converge toward a generic skeleton and the more the matrix flattens into noise — the scrubbing step and the signal the paper needs are pulling against each other, and the source-identification leakage test measures the leakage but not this collapse.
what_would_fix_it: Make predictor dissociation the primary design axis rather than an afterthought: pre-register a task set (16-20 tasks, not 8) containing an explicit discordant subset — at least ~6 pairs that are semantically close but failure-profile distant (e.g., two word-problem sets with different output contracts) and ~6 that are semantically distant but failure-profile close (a code task and an instruction-following task both dominated by contract violations) — and make the correlation restricted to the discordant subset the headline analysis, with the full matrix as secondary. Power the *difference* of correlations at the target-cluster level and report that number, not the single-correlation power at cell level. Report raw uncorrected Spearmans as primary with attenuation correction secondary and a CI on the reliability denominator itself, since a noisy small denominator can manufacture the 0.45-0.65 range. Pre-register what happens to the claim if the signature's discriminative power lives entirely in the format/contract dimension — step (8)(iii) suggests it might, and in that case the finding reduces to 'match the output contract', which should be stated as a pre-committed outcome rather than discovered post hoc. Cut the ablation list (unscrubbed full matrix, Pareto-member variant, second-executor sub-matrix, three taxonomy variants) down to the two that can change a conclusion, and spend the freed compute on more tasks and more seeds per cell.
missing_baseline: Two, both fatal to the router claim if they win. (1) A task-agnostic generic scaffold seed: one domain-general prompt skeleton (role framing, output contract, decomposition, error-avoidance clauses) authored once by a human or an LLM from *no source task at all*, used as the warm start on every target. 'Best-fixed-source' does not cover this — it is still a source-derived artifact selected on the 7 training targets, so it still presupposes the matrix matters. If a generic scaffold matches the routed source at 50 rollouts, the transfer matrix, the failure taxonomy and the router are all unnecessary, and this is the single most likely outcome given that step (2) deliberately scrubs domain content out of every source prompt. (2) A no-predictor pooling arm: seed the Pareto pool with all 7 scrubbed sources simultaneously and let the optimizer's own validation do the selecting. The ablations mention 'warm start as an extra Pareto-pool member' but only for a single routed source; the all-sources pool is the arm that makes routing moot, and it is cheap because candidate validation is far cheaper than a rollout budget. Minor third: the budget accounting never charges the target run for the failure-signature probe or amortized source optimization, so 'matched budget' is matched only in the arm's favor.
preprint_collision: The Preprint Collision Check field is empty — no searches reported, no date window, no arXiv sweep, no named near-misses. Related Work cites SPoT (2021), Vu et al. (2020), ATTEMPT, APE, OPRO, PromptBreeder, MIPROv2 (2024) and GEPA (2025); everything but GEPA is an indexed paper more than a year old, which is precisely the citation profile the reviewing standard here treats as inadequate. This is a weakness, not a neutral: in a subarea where GEPA follow-ups, prompt-library/module-routing methods, and domain-general LLM failure taxonomies (e.g., the 2025 multi-agent failure-taxonomy line of work, which constructs exactly the kind of pre-registered domain-general failure catalogue this proposal's step (5) needs) have all appeared within months, the probability that the specific pairing 'judge-labeled failure taxonomy as a source-selection feature' is untouched cannot be assessed from what the authors provide. I did not search and so cannot name a definitive scoop, but the burden of establishing novelty sits with the submission and has not been discharged; I am discounting novelty by roughly two points on this basis alone, and a discovered collision on the failure-taxonomy-as-routing-feature idea would move this to a clear reject, since the reliability audit alone would then be the whole contribution.
